summary: No static defects found in the scoped change. Previous fixes and rebuttals match the current contract. Numerical results and historical failing-run execution remain unverified because this review explicitly prohibits running checks.

checks.criterion: AC1: Tests written and run failing before implementation, with the failing run recorded
checks.evidence: The ac27c1a tree contains test imports for AEQD symbols absent from its geometry.py. This establishes test-before-implementation ordering, but does not independently establish execution. Historical run claims in notes were not treated as execution evidence.

checks.criterion: AC2: Independent grid formula and hand-computed 5000 m / 90 m corner and centre checks
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/test_geometry_aeqd.py:321-332 independently constructs coordinates with loops; :391-411 asserts all coordinates, four corners and the centre pixel. Implementation is at geometry.py:102-119. Assertions were read but not executed because checks are prohibited in this read-only review.

checks.criterion: AC3: Spherical inverse, exact zero-offset centre including poles, and independent forward round trips
checks.evidence: geometry.py:221-245 computes rho, c, the algebraically equivalent latitude increment and atan2 longitude, with explicit centre returns. Tests at test_geometry_aeqd.py:595-623 cover zero offsets and poles; :672-700 cover both grids, all bodies and specified latitudes against module and independent forward implementations. Numerical tolerances require execution, prohibited here.

checks.criterion: AC4: Independent great-circle distance equals rho to 1e-9 relative for all three radii
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/test_geometry_aeqd.py:296-300 implements haversine independently; :857-867 checks every analysis-grid point for all bodies, specified latitudes and poles using rtol=1e-9 and atol=0. Execution is prohibited in this read-only review.

checks.criterion: AC5: Both D29 grids at every pixel centre, continuous directional properties, unchanged tolerances and documented longitude range
checks.evidence: test_geometry_aeqd.py:73-75 retains the contracted tolerances; :335-340 compares raw metres. Both configured grids are defined at :85-109. The property at :965-1030 round-trips every pixel of the selected grid at random centres. Properties at :1103-1206 check continuous offsets against 40-digit independent references. Range assertions appear at :1025 and :1137. These properties were not executed because checks are prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC6: Terrain geometry uses metres on the body sphere and remains separate from radar and model distances
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/geometry.py:11-18 imports only standard-library modules and NumPy. Radius enters the inverse as rho/radius at :228 and the forward metre scale at :343. No radar or model distance code is imported or reused.

checks.criterion: Previous fixes and rebuttals: static verification
checks.evidence: Raw-metre assertions replace normalization at test_geometry_aeqd.py:339-340; continuous coverage is restored at :1068-1206; full-grid coverage is present at :1023-1030. True-period residuals are carried at geometry.py:323 and :380, while the independent oracle uses unreduced high-precision longitude differences at test_geometry_aeqd.py:245-251. Antimeridian regressions are asserted at :744-751, :822-830 and :918-938. The latitude increment at geometry.py:234-243 is algebraically equivalent to the PRD expression; double-double forward evaluation is present at :334-337. The mpmath dependency is development-only in pipeline/pyproject.toml:19-22 and uv.lock:488-506. Future TypeScript parity remains a T10 requirement.

The listed implementation commits touch only the four scoped paths. No kickoff configuration, observations, gate records or production mock paths are introduced. geometry.py:219-220 and :313-314 reject non-finite inputs rather than coercing missing values to zero.
